name: CHUU
bio: Kim Ji-woo, known professionally by her stage name Chuu (츄), is a South Korean singer, actress and media personality. She is a former member of the South Korean girl group LOONA and its sub-unit, yyxy.

credits.title: The 1st Field Day – Run, Orbit!
credits.overview: The 1st Field Day – Run, Orbit! (Hangul: 제 1회 여름 운동회 - 달려라 오빛!; sometimes referred as to Summer Sports Day or Orbit Field Day) was the first official fan-event of Loossemble. It took place on July 29, 2023 at 1PM in Jamsil Students' Gymnasium, Seoul, South Korea.

credits.title: The Place
credits.overview: On the edge of town, in a dilapidated former public bathhouse, two young artists share a precarious roof, a common dream, and the constant fear of disappearing. credits.title: Wild Eyes: The Woman of the Prince
credits.overview: Eun Woo infiltrates the palace to kill Crown Prince Lee Hyun, only to fall in love with him.

credits.title: CHUU 1ST TINY-CON 'My Palace'
credits.overview: CHUU 1ST TINY-CON 'My Palace' was an online/offline tiny concert held by Chuu. It took place at the Woonjung Green Campus Grand Hall at Sungshin Women’s University in Seoul, South Korea. The concert was held on Saturday, November 4th and Sunday, November 5th, 2023 at 6PM KST. The latter date was broadcast on hellolive.

credits.title: INTO THE-K Concert 2022
credits.overview: A dazzling lineup of artists lit up the stage at the 2022 K-Culture Festival’s “THE-K Concert”. On October 7, the annual K-Culture Festival wrapped up this year’s nine-day run with a star-studded concert at the Seoul Olympic Stadium. credits.overview: On the journey to finding their destiny, the girls of LOONA realize the ultimate discovery to the wonders of the universe in their meeting with Orbit.  LOONA Premier Greeting [D&D] is an online fan event.

credits.title: LOONA [#] Showcase
credits.overview: To celebrate the release of LOONA's second mini album #, the album showcase was held on February 5, 2020 at the YES24 Live Hall in Seoul, South Korea. While 700 people were originally scheduled to attend, the event was instead broadcasted live on VLive as a result of the growing COVID-19 pandemic.

credits.title: Dear Girl
credits.overview: The painting in the museum, "The Prayer Girl," is secretly in love with the curator. Then one day, the girl, who was sold out, finally runs over the work to tell the curator how she feels.
